Name: Noclip Mode
Author: Pathoschild
TagLine: Enable noclip at the press of a button, letting you walk through anything (even map boundaries).
Description:
**Noclip Mode** lets you press a button to walk through anything (even map boundaries).

![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Pathoschild/StardewMods/develop/NoclipMode/docs/animated.gif)
**Translated into Chinese, English, French, German, Hungarian, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, Russian, Spanish, and Turkish ([translations welcome](https://github.com/Pathoschild/StardewMods#translating-the-mods)).**

![](https://i.imgur.com/suHzq2E.png)
1. [Install the latest version of SMAPI](https://smapi.io).
2. Install the mod through ModDrop (or unzip the download into `Stardew Valley/Mods`).
3. Run the game using SMAPI.

![](https://i.imgur.com/j6fpZ3A.png)
Press `F11` to toggle noclip mode. When it's enabled, nothing can stop you.

See [_configure_ in the readme](https://github.com/Pathoschild/StardewMods/blob/stable/NoclipMode#configure) to change the key.

![](https://i.imgur.com/M7KlO44.png)
Compatible with...
* Stardew Valley 1.5 or later;
* Linux, macOS, and Windows;
* single-player and multiplayer.

![](https://i.imgur.com/ccJ4SPZ.png)
